facts.fact: L'Essor reports that Mali's Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) issued a communique dated 5 September 2024 warning that publishing personal data online risks fines of FCFA 5 to 20 million, so the body is in place and acting.

facts.fact: L'Essor reports that the APDP issued a communique dated 5 September 2024 reminding that spreading personal data online is punishable by a fine of FCFA 5 to 20 million.
facts.system: Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP)

facts.fact: The APDP's 5 September 2024 communique, as reported by L'Essor, is a warning to online pages and web TVs about publishing health and judicial data, with no decision on any named controller.
facts.system: Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP)

MLI.note: The document is a data protection authority warning on publishing personal data; it states no cut, no one punished and no criticism of government.
